## Chaining with artifact filtering

For real-world slides, run `seg.artifact` BEFORE `seg.cells` and filter
out artifact-overlapping cells post-hoc:

```python
zs.seg.artifact(wsi, tile_key="tiles", model="grandqc")        # adds wsi.shapes["artifacts"]
zs.seg.cells(wsi, model="instanseg")                           # cells
artifacts_union = wsi.shapes["artifacts"].unary_union
clean_cells = wsi.shapes["cells"][~wsi.shapes["cells"].geometry.intersects(artifacts_union)]
```
